remaining_shared_gaps.partial_spatial_provider: The selected approach manifest condition_prepared flag chooses world rectangles/Array-to-bool versus native local pairs/Variant-to-void. Native optional null is skipped, prepared unknown clears then reports unavailable, known empty is distinct, and explicit nonempty false is rejection. Native pairs use the actual first endpoint plane or endpoint-free root inverse; non-unit/non-quarter-turn grid frames remain unavailable. Footprint and frame changes invalidate one cached conversion. Actual disclosed membership/suppression and source-owned partition topology have shared consumers. Selected finite contacts require their exact native result/owner operands; richer fixed burn/armed/payload studies remain optional unselected alternatives. Source presence does not qualify output.
remaining_shared_gaps.historical_public_selector_scope: Original inventory receipt only; no current producer-absence claim is inferred.
class_gates: Rage/Frenzy holds now use actual condition UUID ownership and unknown-removal clocks. Initial unobserved application, ordinary Rage native output and the separate body-film API remain unqualified.
Frenzy uses the actual public child-to-parent membership relationship and authored activation projection. An old capture lacking that field cannot qualify its current successor.

Second Wind has an original two-faction wounded-fighter/self-heal recording, actual projection checks and a submitted native self-heal draw through seeking/factions/looping. This qualifies that scenario, not all class-native consumers.
Preserve Life has actual declaration/recipient/native-output qualification; Cleansing Touch, Opulent Revival, Turn Undead and Turn Unholy bindings need their own legal scenario/output qualification.
unselected_action_programs: reaction.spell.counterspell uses actual reaction outcome and resource-authored incoming presentation; source assignment is separate from replay/output qualification.
action.fire_breath is not an exact current catalogue/typed action ID; do not alias another breath by name.
actual_attributions: Divine Smite modifies a native occurrence through content_attributions, not a synthetic ActionFact.
runtime_art: Body/head/weapon registrations, body-material stacking and authentic history/appearance/event cohorts need native consumer qualification.
All Factory alternatives must be inspectable without treating them as automatic gameplay bindings.

provider_contract_notes.appearance_provider: Typed appearance definitions prepare actual outfit sheets before admission. Per-condition Factory leases control only opacity; layers follow the body clip/frame/facing. Actual Fly apply/move/view/gear/remove, independent factions, seeking and looping are qualified in agent_docs/APPEARANCE_PROVIDER_COHORT_2026-10-19.md. Unsupported fixed rigs and created-item art remain gaps; there is no new animation controller.
provider_contract_notes.geometry: Authored actor/slot lists select actual admitted optical sources. Body, head and weapon slots are not interchangeable. Source pose work is shared independently of translation; receiver-relative geometry keys avoid repeated co-moving uploads. Distinct outputs still need native qualification.
provider_contract_notes.endpoints: Authored live_endpoints preserve arity, order, actor roles, sockets and requested surface slots. Extra actors require actual native_actor_uuids. Literal review positions, review trajectories and absent roles remain explicit gaps; no fixture coordinates are copied.
provider_contract_notes.delivery_timing: Uses the selected cue launch and contact-minus-launch in the actual two-argument setter. Attached sources with explicit source_launch_local/source_contact_local retain that authored source clock. This supplies timing, not evidence that its native visual release/socket is correct.
provider_contract_notes.event_spheres: Finite payload/exhale contacts consume their own applied-result/save/recipient and preserve original caster separately from accepted acting recipient. Direct release uses the actual completed caster and disclosed ground aim or exact created bead placement before flight timing. Freezing immediate blast proves direct declaration ancestry; delayed blast proves actual item/lifetime retirement. Neither uses an occurrence key as a retained payload/grant UUID. Divine Word uses actual child memberships/death. Vitriolic END requires its exact before-member source_condition_uuid and actual recipient END ancestry. Current attributed packets can bind; historical packets without that attribution remain unavailable and are never filled from a newer producer. Exact channels are conditional providers, not proof of actual operands or pixels for every source.
provider_contract_notes.surface_state: Only the selected observed-ice source consumes this shape. Actual current spatial UUID/content and unsuppressed disclosed cells provide its optical occupancy gate, with original factual topology retained only to clear absent/suppressed visibility. The delivered128-cell source replaces the old32-cell capacity gap for real49-cell ice owners. Review state/2.6-second retirement are cleared; current spatial ownership handles disclosure loss and seek. No damage, slip, gameplay activity, retained power or inferred rounds are supplied.
provider_contract_notes.body_material: Current visible body layers and private material revisions are supplied. Focused setter/restoration tests cover private ownership; this does not qualify all treatments, stacking, outfits, animation revisions or final pixels.
provider_contract_notes.admitted_cells: The selected approach manifest condition_prepared flag chooses world rectangles/Array-to-bool versus native local pairs/Variant-to-void. Native optional null is skipped, prepared unknown clears then reports unavailable, known empty is distinct, and explicit nonempty false is rejection. Native pairs use the actual first endpoint plane or endpoint-free root inverse; non-unit/non-quarter-turn grid frames remain unavailable. Footprint and frame changes invalidate one cached conversion.
provider_contract_notes.pose_provider: A non-capture operation needs no pose packet. Actual original condition admission is retained through ordered immutable cuts; Flesh to Stone native captured-pose/restoration and the separate logical capture gates qualify their scope. Current geometry is never substituted for history.
provider_contract_notes.actor_context: The three delivered actor-history modes consume genuine immutable original draw operands: actual current Mirror copies with disclosed count; bounded real Blur predecessors; Banishment original pre-cut departure even when the actor is canonically absent. Shared native gate294, logical history350 and departure436 are green on independent originals/all quarters/seek/teardown. Actual gear-transition/live surprise cost and whole-package visual approval are not inferred.
provider_contract_notes.created_item_identity: The typed creationIdentity descriptor joins an actual lifetime admission and unique descendant inventory admission under its completed original cast. Metadata publishes on the later actual commit. Actual current item/holder/lifetime gates native identity/weapon delivery; absent subjective ancestry stays unavailable. Actual authored created-weapon bodies use their exact admitted item/lifetime/holding and selected body source; unobserved subjective ancestry or unsupported holders still refuse. Historical producer155 evidence and current native output qualification remain separate.
provider_contract_notes.weapon_binding: Exact authored weapon/offhand slots cross-check displayed layer item UUID and canonical visual_loadout. Wrong owner, absent current item, ambiguous holder and any additional admission fields actually consumed by the selected source remain explicit per-occurrence refusals; they are not a universal missing item-owner claim. Active Antimagic suppression is retired in schema16; its absent token is not a provider gap. Magic Weapon/Sacred Weapon use their actual public item-effect memberships; actor ledgers do not duplicate those owners. See agent_docs/WEAPON_PROVIDER_COHORT_2026-10-19.md; setter-contract checks do not qualify production pixels.
provider_contract_notes.construction: Explicit application_result cues join native cast lineage/application UUID, matching saving throw and applied damage before public Source.make. observed_event cues join their source declaration to real positive heals, recipient-local removals and dead-to-alive changes. Application facts cannot repeat the source invocation. Private phase input data replaces only declared component operands; shared Resources and native facts stay immutable. Static selection cannot construct a successful fixture. Circle has one cast source plus four real recipients, and Preserve Life has one source plus two real receiving draws. Distinct consumers still need native qualification.
